clips.rk_vihje_myota: Clockwise is the way the hands of a clock go. That way screws and nuts get tight.
clips.rk_vihje_vasta: Anticlockwise is against the clock's hands. That way screws and nuts come loose.
clips.rk_r_kierra: Screw it in. Turn your finger round clockwise.

clips.rk_r_vihje_torx: The screw head has a star. Find the star tip.
clips.rk_r_vihje_kolo: The screw head has a hexagon hole. Find the hexagon tip.
clips.rk_r_pidike: The screw wobbles. Put the holder round it.
clips.rk_r_vihje_pidike: Drag the orange holder to the screw. It keeps the screw straight.
clips.rk_r_vie_reikaan: Put the screw in the hole.
clips.rk_v_naulaa: Hammer the nails in. Tap a nail.

clips.rk_v_vihje_osu: Wait until the hammer is right over the nail. Hit the head straight.
clips.rk_v_pihdit: Hold the nail with the pliers. Bring the pliers to the nail.
clips.rk_v_kaatui: The nail fell over. Hold it with pliers first, so your fingers stay safe.
clips.rk_v_pysyy: Now the nail stands by itself. Keep going!
clips.rk_v_vie_naula: Put the nail on the red mark.
clips.rk_v_ponto: Let's build a birdhouse! Hammer the nails in.
clips.rk_j_saada: Make the wrench fit the nut. Drag the wheel.

clips.rk_j_liian_pieni: Too small, it doesn't go on the nut.
clips.rk_j_vihje_valitse: Look at the wrench's mouth. It must be as wide as the nut.
clips.rk_j_kirista: Tighten the nut. Pull the handle clockwise.
clips.rk_j_avaa: Loosen the nut. Pull the handle anticlockwise.
clips.rk_m_vihje_pidempi: Let's line the boards up at one end. See which goes furthest.
clips.rk_m_palikat: How many blocks long is the board?

clips.rk_s_sahaa_nyt: Saw it through. Back and forth.

clips.rk_s_vihje_puu: A board is cut with a hand saw. It has big teeth and a wooden handle.
clips.rk_s_vihje_metalli: A metal pipe is cut with a hacksaw. Its blade has small teeth.
clips.rk_s_vihje_oksa: A branch is cut with a bow saw. It is shaped like a bow.
clips.rk_s_vihje_kuvio: Thin boards and curves are cut with a fret saw. Its blade is thin.
clips.rk_s_suojaimet: A grown-up uses the circular saw. Pick what they need.
clips.rk_s_g_kapula: With the push stick, hands stay far from the blade.
clips.rk_s_ei_tarvita: That's not needed with the saw.

clips.rk_s_kaynnista: Now the saw can be started. Press the green button.

clips.rk_s_sammuta: The board is cut. Press the red button.
clips.rk_s_odota: Wait until the blade stops completely.

clips.rk_s_ota: Now the blade has stopped. Take the piece.
clips.rk_p_valitse: Pick the bit as thick as the wall plug.
